details.title: Problem-to-Product Planner
details.summary: Start with a real problem. Turn scattered ideas into one small, testable offer.
details.description: Too many product ideas, and no clear place to start? This printable planner helps you capture evidence of a problem, choose who to help, and design a small experiment before spending weeks building. Work through three practical pages at your own pace.
details.audience: For first-time creators, freelancers and curious builders deciding what to make next.
details.file_note: 3-page PDF · A4 · English · Print or annotate digitally
